title: Ribbon Bead Bracelet
metal: 18k gold tone (PVD 18k gold tone coating on surgical stainless steel), polished, one tone only. There is no rhodium silver tone version.
finish: Polished, high-shine 18k gold tone metal; clear, brilliant-faceted heart-cut cubic zirconia.
lock: Hair-fine 1.2mm cable chain, all 18k gold tone, adjustable 16-19cm, lobster clasp and short extender, with 6 tiny 2mm round beads, 3 each side. Centre: exactly 2 separate 5mm heart-cut clear cubic zirconia, points meeting under 1 polished bar, held by 4 fine claws at the outer lobes, reading as a tiny bow 10 x 5.5mm. Must stay 2 distinct hearts at little-fingernail scale, never one merged stone, a ribbon bow, or larger.
morph: The crystal bow. Image models draw it 1.3-1.5x too large (listing worn photos 05 and 08 and the earlier ad S4_19 already do), merge the 2 hearts into 1 stone, turn the hearts points-outward, drop the small polished bar over the join, or replace the whole thing with a fabric ribbon or a solid metal bow. Second drift: the lobster clasp turns into a spring ring and the 6 beads multiply to 12-16 (listing photos 06 and 07, both AI-generated, show both).
sizeMm: Listed: adjustable 160-190 mm; 1.2 mm cable chain; 2 mm beads; 2 hearts about 5 mm each; bow about 10 mm wide x 5.5 mm tall (the size guide prints 1 cm x 0.55 cm); weight 2 g. Bead count of 6 (3 each side) is counted from photos 01 and 04, not listed. Referents: the bow is about half a Rs 1 coin (20 mm) across, about the width of a little-finger nail, and about 2/3 the length of the green cardamom pod in photo 04. On the wrist it is a small glint, about 1/5 of the wrist's width.
refNotes: Reused the ads-500 ids from products.md after checking they match the current listing. Ref 1 (pack) is pixel-identical to listing image 01 (ribbon-bead-bracelet-0; mean difference 0.19/255 at 256 px): the whole piece on a plaster cube, with the bow, 6 beads, the lobster clasp and the extender. Ref 2 (macro) is pixel-identical to listing image 03 (mean difference 0.23/255): the clearest view of the bow, showing 2 hearts points-in, the polished bar over the join and 4 claws at the outer lobes. It is AI-generated but agrees with the supplier diagram (11). For scale, the macro has no referent. Lean on photo 04 (cardamom flat lay, construction and scale both right) or the 'little-fingernail' line in the prompt. Avoid 06 and 07 as references (spring-ring clasp, too many beads).
claims: Waterproof, Tarnish Free, Hypoallergenic (all three tagged; the care text also says 'Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine').
variants: 1 variant: Default Title, SKU YF8156, stock 21, 18k gold tone. Show it (every photo is this variant). Never render a rhodium silver tone version.
copyNotes: Use: 'Two hearts, read as a bow' (the listing's own opening), 'TWO HEARTS. / ONE BOW.' (founder-keep headline, colour/66), crystal bow, heart-cut cubic zirconia, 18k gold tone, PVD, surgical stainless steel, satellite chain, adjustable 16-19 cm, 2 g, 'light enough to forget you are wearing it', Rs 699 (compare-at Rs 999), waterproof, tarnish free, hypoallergenic, 'pair it with a fine chain bracelet'. Avoid: 'gold' alone, and the listing's 'gold satellite beads' and 'fine gold claws' as written (say 18k gold tone beads and claws); solid gold, diamond, Swarovski, silver, pearl or pearls (the beads are metal), 'beaded bracelet' or 'charm bracelet' (it is a chain), bangle, cuff, pendant, huggie; 'anti-tarnish' (say tarnish free, the tag); 'ribbon' as a description of the piece (it is only the name: there is no fabric). Offer line only with a verified code: 'EAR AND WRIST.' pairs it with Brushed Gold Huggies, also Rs 699.
story: A gift that arrives already wrapped: the bow sits on the wrist, made of 2 crystal hearts turned point to point under a tiny polished knot. It is 2 g and Rs 699, the easy yes for any gift budget under Rs 1,000. Two hearts read as two people: you and her, sisters, the best friend, the bride and her girls. Rhymes with the bow on a gift box (the blush Naira box), a satin hair ribbon, the bow on a ballet flat, a butterfly's 2 wings, a bow tie, a shoelace knot, a ribboned mithai box, 'tying the knot' in wedding season, and a thread tied on a wrist for luck. It sits on the coquette bow wave (bows on everything) without being a costume. Timing in late November: wedding season (bridesmaid sets), Secret Santa under Rs 700, Christmas, New Year, then Galentine's and Valentine's. Founder keeps: colour/15 and colour/66 (navy satin bow, 'TWO HEARTS. / ONE BOW.'). Earlier flop: crazy42 lost the piece inside a bouquet, so keep the bracelet the hero of the frame. Stock 21, a slow seller to clear.
